title: items block, schema 2: world stash and pickup vocabulary
description: docs/kernel-schema.md §7 (K-R45..K-R47). stash = things the world already hides, each at a node (the row contract of map/core/stash.mjs with node in place of map + marker). pickup = per-language additions to the kernel's pickup vocabulary. What the player carries is not pack data: it lives in the chat variable (<chat var>.stash) and is recomputable from the chat.

id.description: Stable id; default = a hash of node|hidden|name (map/core/stash.mjs rowId rule).

hidden.description: Name of the hiding spot (drawer, loose board); finding it is harder.

dc.description: Search difficulty (d20 >= dc). Default 10; hidden adds 3.

verbs.description: Extra acquisition verbs (strict: verb + concrete noun).

verbs_off.description: Kernel verbs this pack switches off (idioms of its setting).

not_items.description: Extra words that are never items (abstract nouns).
